stops.name: Barnim Nature Park
stops.detail: Barnim Nature Park is about 750 square kilometres (ca. 290 sq miles) in size and the only joint large-scale reserve of the Federal States of Brandenburg and Berlin. About 5.4% of the area is located in the North Berlin city districts of Pankow and Reinickendorf. The Brandenburg part of the nature park is situated between Bernau, Bad Freienwalde, Eberswalde, Liebenwalde and Oranienburg.
